verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage publishes a per-endpoint API reference (monitoring, exports, audit, transactions) and an official Postman collection that gives users runnable requests. The OpenAPI schema is downloadable and was retrieved and parsed as OpenAPI 3.0.3. However, no evidence shows the reference pages themselves are interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console or embedded runnable code samples, so runnability relies on the Postman import. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-page interactive/try-it API console, runnable code examples within the reference, independent hands-on corroboration.
